blocks.content: Mastery of subject-specific terminology is the foundation of clear analytical reasoning in competitive examinations.

items: Pay special attention to closely related terms that are often swapped in tricky multiple-choice options.
Direct definition-based and 'Match the Following' questions are frequently framed from standard glossaries.
Use exact technical terms from the official glossary in Mains descriptive answers to maximize evaluation scores.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Glossaries establish precise legal, constitutional, and technical definitions required across competitive exam syllabi.
Standardized terminology eliminates ambiguity in objective questions and conceptual statements.
Mastering key terms improves conceptual clarity and speed during exam revisions.
Incorporating subject-specific keywords directly enhances answer quality and technical precision in Mains descriptive papers.
